newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Changcheng Steel posts first-half loss.
newsitem.headline: Changcheng Steel posts first-half loss.

text.p: Sichuan Changcheng Special Steel Co Ltd said on Friday that it incurred a loss of 143.68 million yuan in the first half of 1996 against net earnings of 14.75 million yuan in the same period last year.
In an interim report published in the Securities Times, the company said that under Chinese accounting standards, it lost 0.22 yuan per share in the first half.
It did not give a figure for the same period last year.
Main operating income fell to 918.44 million yuan from 932.21 million yuan the previous year, the report said.

The firm said its interim loss was caused by a number of factors, including price rises for raw materials, electricity, coal and natural gas, funding shortages and an oversupply in China's steel market.
This caused a 42 million yuan rise in Changcheng's production costs, a drop of 22.29 percent in its steel output and an average fall of 135 yuan per tonne in its steel sale price, it said.
The company had reported after-tax profits of 9.39 million yuan for 1995, down from 200.98 million yuan in 1994.
